open_points.subject: A3 INV-07 Required tests
open_points.text: a replaced file whose new content has no placement is reported as a new photo with the READY member of = models.ScanStatus
open_points.question: Must this expectation be limited to new content that passes A1 orders 1 to 6, or must even rejected or ignored replacement content be reported as READY?
options: Qualify it as content that passes A1 orders 1 to 6 and is not ignored
Report every replacement without a placement as READY
Keep A1 precedence, so rejected or ignored replacement content is not READY
open_points.default_guess: Qualify the test case as an ordinary file whose new content passes A1 orders 1 to 6.

witness.initial: A project has an earlier placed and marked source file; no placement exists for the hash of empty content.
events: Syncthing replaces the source file with an empty regular file.
The caller scans the project folder.
outcomes: A1 order 1 reports the file as REJECTED with reason EMPTY.
The changed INV-07 Required tests sentence requires the replaced file, whose new content has no placement, to be reported as READY.
witness.observer: The calling flow reading the scan result

open_points.subject: A3 INV-07 Required tests
open_points.text: a replaced file whose new content has no placement is reported as a new photo with the READY member of = models.ScanStatus while the earlier image and mark stay
open_points.question: What Required tests case shows that INV-07 also preserves the earlier placement, stored image and mark when the replacement content already has a placement in the same project?
options: Require cases for both replacement content with no placement and replacement content with an existing placement
Limit the witness to replacement content with no placement
Narrow INV-07 to replacement content with no placement
open_points.default_guess: Require both cases and explicitly assert that the earlier placement, stored image and mark remain unchanged in each.
